test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tab ( id UInt64, message String, title String, INDEX idx_message(message) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha'), INDEX idx_title(title) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tab SELECT number, concat( arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('w', toString(cityHash64(number, i) % 1000)), range(8)), ' '), multiIf(number % 10007 = 0, ' foobar ', number % 10009 = 1, ' helloworld ', number % 10037 = 2, ' clickhouse ', ' '), arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('w', toString(cityHash64(number, i + 8) % 1000)), range(8)), ' ')), concat('event ', toString(number % 100000)) FROM numbers(5000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE match(message, ' foobar | helloworld ')
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE match(message, ' foobar | helloworld | clickhouse | nothing1 | nothing2 | nothing3 | nothing4 | nothing5 ')
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE multiSearchAny(message, [' foobar ', ' helloworld ', ' clickhouse ', ' nothing1 ', ' nothing2 ', ' nothing3 ', ' nothing4 ', ' nothing5 '])

SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE multiSearchAny(message, [' nothing0 ', ' nothing1 ', ' nothing2 ', ' nothing3 ', ' nothing4 ', ' nothing5 ', ' nothing6 ', ' nothing7 ', ' nothing8 ', ' nothing9 ', ' nothing10 ', ' nothing11 ', ' nothing12 ', ' foobar ', ' helloworld ', ' clickhouse '])
